purpose: Four-layer runtime for a diagram-backed model. The .puml is the live model. Host holds irreducible primitives only.

layers.name: Model
layers.role: Common evaluate surface. Any scoring or hunt model.

layers.name: PumlModel
layers.role: A Model whose policy is a parsed PlantUML activity document.

layers.name: PumlModelFactory
layers.role: Syntax: PUML text in, flow graph out. No I/O. Fail closed on unknown activity syntax.

layers.name: PumlEngine
layers.role: Walks the flow graph. Does not encode hunt arithmetic or hunt labels. Named primitives go to PumlHost.

host.name: PumlHost
host.role: Irreducible primitive catalog. Hunt formulas, ifs, and coefficients live in the .puml.
host.evaluate: evaluate(phrase, env) -> ModelValue. Unknown phrases are Missing.
host.call: call(name, args, env, document) -> ModelValue. Names: count, robust_mean, median, ols, ramp, clamp, min, max, sign, percentile, foreign, classify.
host.decorateEmit: decorateEmit(name, fields, env, flags, document) -> fields. Default is identity. Reasons are written in the box.

emission.name: PascalCase box label
emission.fields: arg and/or reason copied from the box

activityDialect.functionPartition: partition "name(p, q)" registers a document function. Not walked as main flow. Call binds args by position and returns the last assignment.
activityDialect.bareCall: non-emit activity box with no = or ←; host.evaluate

invariants: Engine.run walks the flow graph and does not hard-code hunt formulas or hunt labels.
A process loads each PUML source once at start. A restart sees edits. Mid-run reload is out of scope.
Tape, Street consensus EPS, and Quant Engine stay out unless a document names them.
A new partition, a new if, a changed coefficient, or a changed hunt formula is a PUML edit. It does not require Kotlin.
A call resolves document.functions first, then the Kotlin host lib.
Hunt functions live in the same .puml as callable partitions named name(params).
host.call is the Kotlin primitive lib included at load. The diagram supplies hunt identities.
A new hunt is a new PUML document. It needs a new host only when it needs a new primitive name.

extensibility.newHunt: new .puml; new host.call names only when a new primitive is required
